name: Jaymilee Hair

description: Jaymilee Hair is Katy's hair studio for rich brunette and copper color, flattering cuts with perfect bangs and face-framing layers, and glossy blowouts — healthy, polished hair that suits you.

hero.title: Polished hair, made for you.
hero.subtitle: Rich brunette and copper color, cuts with perfect bangs, and glossy blowouts by Katy — book your appointment at Jaymilee Hair today.

stylists.name: Katy
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Katy is the stylist behind Jaymilee Hair. She loves rich brunettes and warm copper tones, flattering cuts with perfectly placed bangs, and glossy, healthy finishes — polished hair that feels completely you.

reviews.name: Rebecca T.
reviews.text: Katy cut the perfect bangs for my face shape — I've never loved my hair more!

reviews.name: Amanda J.
reviews.text: My copper color is so rich and shiny. She really knows how to make warm tones glow.

reviews.name: Nicole F.
reviews.text: Gray coverage that actually lasts and looks natural. Katy is so detail-oriented.

reviews.name: Kristen W.
reviews.text: Warm, professional, and talented. I always leave Jaymilee feeling polished and confident.
